notes.title: My Friend's Family is updated to v0.14.3
notes.notes:
Hi,

My Friend's Family is updated to v0.14.3 now.

This update didn't fix anything in the game, but it fixed the walkthrough. If you played with the walkhthrough, it suggested that you should refuse to work with Lori (Week 07 - Sunday). But it was a wrong choice. You should agree to work with her on that day, so she will help you later.

This update also added scenes (without text) of v0.15.

Thank you!

notes.title: My Friend's Family is updated to v0.14.1
notes.notes:
Hi,

My Friend's Family is updated to v0.14.1 now. This small update doesn't have new scenes. It only fixed the Netorase & Netorare routes.

If you play these routes without using the walkthroughs, you can still use previous saves and enjoy the game. But if you play with walkthroughs, please check the walkthroughs because I re-arranged a few things in the walkthroughs.

For other routes (not Netorase & Netorare), there are just a few minor changes. And I think there's no need to check at all. But if I'm wrong, I'm very sorry.

Thank you!

notes.title: My Friend's Family - 0.14.0 is released
notes.notes:
Hi,

My Friend's Family is updated to v0.14.0 now. Since this is the first release on Steam, I don't have previous releases to list new scenes / routes here. But compared to v0.14-alpha & beta, v0.14.0 added more scenes for Karen in the Sharing route.

And because updating on Steam is difficult, especially after they blocked Steam in my country, the game will only be updated after 2 releases (the next release will be v0.16). You know, it took me an hour just to get the verification code to update the game on Steam just now.

Thank you for your support & understanding!
